features.basis: TP53 mutation is highly enriched in sensitive lines and loss of p53-mediated post-mitotic arrest/apoptosis is a known determinant of microtubule-inhibitor sensitivity
KRAS mutations appear in multiple sensitive lung/pancreas/colorectal lines and RAS-MAPK activation can enhance mitotic vulnerability
NRAS-mutant lines (NCIH1299, NCIH1573, RL952) are among the most sensitive
BRAF-mutant lines appear in both sensitive and resistant groups, but several sensitive melanoma/endometrial lines carry BRAF mutations
PIK3CA mutations are enriched in several sensitive breast/gastric/urinary lines
PTEN loss co-occurs in sensitive melanoma, glioma, thyroid, and endometrial lines
SMAD4 mutation appears in sensitive gastric, pancreatic, and colorectal lines
FBXW7 mutation appears in multiple sensitive lung, pancreatic, and colorectal lines
STK11 mutation appears in sensitive lung lines but also in resistant lines, so weaker evidence
ARID1A mutation appears in several sensitive endometrial, pancreatic, and colorectal lines
ALK-altered neuroblastoma lines (SKNSH, KELLY) are among the least affected
CDKN2A mutation appears in several resistant lines, though also in some sensitive lines, so weak evidence

raw.explanation: Nocodazole is a microtubule-destabilizing agent that arrests cells in mitosis; sensitivity is therefore expected to track with features that increase reliance on microtubule-dependent mitotic processes or reduce the ability to arrest/survive in mitosis. The strongest pattern in the observed lines is that TP53-mutant, highly aneuploid/aggressive carcinomas (many with KRAS/NRAS/BRAF/PIK3CA/PTEN alterations) are enriched among sensitive lines, whereas several BRAF-mutant melanoma/glioma and ALK-fusion neuroblastoma lines are relatively resistant, consistent with lineage- and checkpoint-dependent differences in mitotic arrest and apoptosis. A plausible mechanism is that loss of p53-mediated post-mitotic checkpoint/apoptosis and activation of RAS/PI3K-BRAF growth signaling sensitize cells to microtubule disruption, while intact p53 or specific lineage contexts (e.g., ALK-driven neuroblastoma, some BRAF-mutant melanoma) are protective.
